name: @robrowser-webgpu/gpu-webgpu
description: gpu-webgpu backend of the reimagined renderer: device, MSAA offscreen target + blit, precompiled pipelines, texture-array residency, world, sprite runs, effects, GR2, post chain, live previews, capture, device-loss rebuild with WebGL2 fallback.
